payload.body: You tend to notice books, classes, trips, and conversations that give an unconventional belief somewhere practical to go. The idea becomes more useful when it can be tested against actual experience instead of protected as a private exception. You may hesitate because changing your mind once felt disloyal or irresponsible. Try the belief in one concrete part of life before asking it to explain everything.
